technique_name: Explain the difference between modal and non-modal dialogs.
description: Modal dialogs are pop-up windows that open and close independently of any other window, while non-modal dialog boxes appear within a single window and must be completed before other actions can take place in the application. Modal dialogs, also known as modal windows, are typically used to provide time-sensitive information or other important notifications and often have some type of "OK" or "Cancel" button to proceed and close the dialog.
